test_cases.name: Strict JSON format across all 5 models
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect structured output completions from all 5 models
test_cases.expected_result: Pure valid JSON produced; zero markdown backtick code blocks
test_cases.evidence: All 5 models return clean, parseable JSON without markdown backtick wrappers

test_cases.name: Nested structure integrity
test_cases.input_setup: Parse multi-level nested clinical JSON containing ICD-10 sub-codes and categories
test_cases.expected_result: Nested dictionaries and lists fully preserved without structure corruption
test_cases.evidence: Deeply nested ICD-10 hierarchy preserved intact without truncation or type flattening

test_cases.name: Arabic medical terms in JSON payload
test_cases.input_setup: Parse JSON containing Arabic clinical terms with UTF-8 encoding
test_cases.expected_result: UTF-8 decoded correctly; no character corruption or mojibake
test_cases.evidence: Arabic UTF-8 medical strings parsed and serialized losslessly: ألم حاد في الصدر مع ضيق في التنفس

test_cases.name: Red-flag content filter resilience
test_cases.input_setup: Submit emergency room clinical note containing suicide/self-harm ingestion mentions
test_cases.expected_result: Content filter does NOT block; valid clinical extraction output generated
test_cases.evidence: Emergency clinical narrative with overdose/self-harm context processed without content filter block

test_cases.name: Max token response completion
test_cases.input_setup: Evaluate completion finish_reason on high-token clinical documentation payload
test_cases.expected_result: Completed with finish_reason='stop'; no premature 'length' truncation
test_cases.evidence: Long clinical response completed normally with finish_reason='stop' (not truncated)
